title: Which Waiting Crossover Line a Settlement Is Worked Out From
content:
Where more than one crossover line stands waiting on a policy under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies, which line the settlement is worked out from, and which recorded liability is the figure taken, is settled from Medicare's determinations on those lines.

1. **Where more than one line stands waiting on the supplement and Medicare's determination is recorded on only one of them** — the determined line is the one settled, and its recorded liability is the figure taken.
2. **Where more than one line stands waiting and each carries Medicare's determination** — the liabilities those lines record are taken together and settled as one.
3. **Where neither of those holds** — the line most recently rendered is settled, and its recorded liability is the figure taken.

### Reading the three cases

The first two cases both require more than 1 line standing waiting. They part on how many of those lines carry Medicare's determination: exactly one in the first case, every one of them in the second.

Where only 1 line stands waiting, neither of the first two cases is reached, and the line most recently rendered — which is that line — is settled on its own recorded liability.

The first case takes a single line's recorded liability. The second takes the liabilities of all the waiting lines added together, and settles them as one.

### Hypothetical records

Three lines stand waiting, and Medicare's determination is recorded on 1 of them, which records the policyholder owing 180.00: that line is settled and 180.00 is the figure taken.

Three lines stand waiting and each carries Medicare's determination, recording 60.00, 45.00 and 75.00: the liabilities are taken together as 180.00 and settled as one.

One line stands waiting, recording 180.00: it is the line most recently rendered, and 180.00 is the figure taken.
